narrative.overview: Kairos is a board you glance at before sending the next task somewhere. The surfaces are quiet, warm-neutral and flat; the only loud thing on screen is a status colour, and the loudest sentence is the recommendation with its reason. Nothing decorates.
keyCharacteristics: Flat: no shadows, depth from surface steps and 0.5px hairlines.
One lane: a 720px column centred on a sunk page background.
Status colour is the only chroma; everything else is warm grey.
System font, small sizes, weight 500 for emphasis.
Every state is legible without colour.

rules.name: The Chroma-Is-Meaning Rule
rules.body: Colour appears only to say something about a quota or a selection. Decorative colour is off limits.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Rule
rules.body: Status colour on text always uses the *-text variant; the raw signal colours are for fills, dots and bars.

rules.name: The Tokenise-The-Status Rule
rules.body: New status surfaces must use tokens, not literals.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: One sans family, one mono. Hierarchy is size plus weight 500, not new fonts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows. If something must lift, change its surface step or its border.

dos: Do use the --color-* and --radius-md / --radius-lg tokens for every new surface, border and radius.
Do pair every status colour with a text label or badge so meaning survives without colour.
Do use the *-text colour variants for any coloured text.
Do keep controls at least 32px (36-40px on phones) and add touch-action: manipulation.
Do give every interactive control a visible :focus-visible treatment.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, gradients or glass effects; depth is tonal.
Don't introduce a second font family or weights above 600.
Don't hardcode hex values in a component.
Don't use raw signal colours for text on pale backgrounds.
Don't add decorative colour, illustration or iconography with no quota meaning.
